content: CAN-SPAM requires unsubscribe link on every commercial message including drip/follow-up steps and honoring opt-out within 10 business days; common failure is per-list unsubscribe not propagating to a global suppression list so a contact unsubscribed from one flow keeps getting others. GDPR requires unsubscribe to be as easy as signup and erasure requests to be honored within a month across all stores including suppression records.
